properties.description: EIP-2935 activation check must occur before any block hash storage system call
properties.formal_spec: FORALL block: block.processing_started => EIP2935_activated(block.number) CHECKED_BEFORE system_call_initiated
properties.rationale: The system call must only execute after EIP-2935 is active to prevent premature state modifications

properties.description: Storage slot computed as ring buffer index using modulo HISTORY_SERVE_WINDOW
properties.rationale: Incorrect slot computation would overwrite wrong block hashes or create gaps in history

properties.description: System call must complete before any user transactions are processed in the block
properties.rationale: Ensures deterministic state for contracts querying block hashes during transaction execution

properties.description: Calldata validation requires exactly 32 bytes before processing retrieval
properties.rationale: Prevents malformed requests from causing undefined behavior in hash retrieval

properties.description: Requests for blocks outside valid window must revert
properties.formal_spec: POST: (block_num < current_block - 8191 OR block_num >= current_block) => call.reverted
properties.rationale: Prevents returning stale or invalid hash data for out-of-range blocks

properties.description: Only SYSTEM_ADDRESS (0xff..fe) can execute set operations
properties.rationale: Trust boundary - unauthorized writes would allow attackers to inject false block hashes

properties.description: Non-system callers are treated as get operations regardless of input
properties.rationale: Ensures graceful handling of unauthorized set attempts without revert

properties.description: System call gas does not count against block gas limit
properties.rationale: Ensures full block gas limit remains available for user transactions

properties.description: System call does not trigger EIP-1559 base fee burn
properties.rationale: Prevents artificial ETH burn from protocol-level operations

properties.description: Branch poisoning attack cost must exceed potential benefit
properties.rationale: Economic security assumption protecting state trie integrity

properties.description: Base fee calculation requires parent block gas_used, gas_limit, and base_fee_per_gas
properties.formal_spec: PRE: base_fee_calculation => parent.gas_used DEFINED AND parent.gas_limit DEFINED AND parent.base_fee_per_gas DEFINED
properties.rationale: Missing parent data would cause undefined base fee calculation

properties.description: Base fee increase capped at 12.5% (1/8) of previous base fee
properties.rationale: Prevents excessive fee spikes that could destabilize transaction inclusion

properties.description: Base fee decrease capped at 12.5% (1/8) of previous base fee
properties.rationale: Prevents excessive fee drops that could enable block stuffing attacks

properties.description: Base fee unchanged when gas usage exactly equals target
properties.rationale: Ensures stable fees when demand matches target capacity

properties.description: Transaction type detection must occur on all incoming transactions before processing
properties.rationale: Trust boundary - external transaction bytes must be correctly classified

properties.description: EIP-1559 effective gas price calculation: min(max_priority_fee, max_fee - base_fee) + base_fee
properties.formal_spec: POST: effective_price == min(max_priority_fee_per_gas, max_fee_per_gas - base_fee_per_gas) + base_fee_per_gas
properties.rationale: Incorrect effective price would cause incorrect fee accounting

properties.description: Legacy and EIP-2930 transactions use gas_price as effective price
properties.formal_spec: INVARIANT: (tx.type == LEGACY OR tx.type == 0x01) => effective_price == tx.gas_price
properties.rationale: Ensures backward compatibility for non-EIP-1559 transactions

properties.description: Access list gas cost: 2400 per address + 1900 per storage key
properties.rationale: Correct gas accounting ensures fair pricing for pre-declared storage access

properties.description: All access list addresses and storage keys marked as warm after processing
properties.formal_spec: POST: FORALL addr IN access_list.addresses: addr.is_warm AND FORALL key IN access_list.storage_keys: key.is_warm
properties.rationale: Pre-warming enables reduced gas costs for subsequent accesses

properties.description: Maximum gas refund capped at 20% of gas consumed (London change from 50%)
properties.rationale: 20% cap prevents gas token arbitrage that distorts block space pricing

properties.description: Actual refund never exceeds minimum of refund counter and max refund
properties.rationale: Ensures refund cap is consistently applied

properties.description: Voluntary exit signature must be validated before processing
properties.rationale: Prevents unauthorized exits without valid validator signature

properties.description: Signature validation must use fixed Capella fork domain, not current fork
properties.rationale: Trust boundary - ensures perpetual validity across forks as specified by EIP-7044

properties.description: Validator exit is irreversible once initiated
properties.rationale: Exit process cannot be cancelled once started

properties.description: Post-EIP-7044, signing domain is permanently fixed to Capella fork version
properties.rationale: Domain locking ensures exits remain valid across all future fork upgrades

properties.description: Pre-EIP-7044: exit signatures invalid after 2 fork upgrades
properties.rationale: Documents legacy behavior that EIP-7044 fixes

properties.description: Only validator key holder can create valid exit signatures
properties.rationale: Trust boundary - key holder has exclusive authority to initiate exits

properties.description: Signed exit can be replayed on forked chains - expected behavior
properties.rationale: Cross-fork replay is accepted security consideration, not a vulnerability

properties.description: Voluntary exits do not transfer funds - only initiate exit process
properties.rationale: Core security property - exits are exit-only, funds remain until withdrawal

properties.description: Validator can restake on forked chain after replay-triggered exit
properties.rationale: Provides recovery option if exit was replayed against validator's wishes
